beta.notes:
New in this version:
• When your work folder cannot be reached, Work Sample Buddy shows one clear screen explaining what is safe on this computer, which folder is unavailable, and the available choices. It rechecks automatically and does not treat the situation as a new install.
• Choosing a different folder while the usual one is offline checks for existing files, asks before saving elsewhere, and offers to switch back when the usual folder returns.

Fixes:
• The saved work folder is no longer forgotten after continuing without files during a Google Drive outage, preventing the next launch from looking like first-time setup.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
